faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.a1: Planning Poker is a consensus-based technique used mainly in Scrum to estimate the effort or relative complexity of software development tasks.
faq.a2: We’re evolving continuously and offer access so you can try the full estimation flow with your team.
faq.q3: Do I need to install anything?
faq.a3: No. Everything runs in the browser — just create or join a room and start.
faq.a4: You can choose ready-made decks or create a custom deck with the values that make sense for your team.
